rules.description: Applicant must be living in England
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for registering with a GP practice in England. For Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland, contact your local health board.

rules.description: Applicant must live within the GP practice's catchment area
rules.reason_if_failed: You are outside this practice's catchment area. The practice must accept patients living in their area.

rules.description: Applicant must have a verifiable address
rules.reason_if_failed: An address is required to verify you are in the practice's catchment area

edge_cases.description: Applicant is homeless or of no fixed abode
edge_cases.action: Route to specialist homeless healthcare team. Patient still entitled to register but may need support finding appropriate practice.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is a member of armed forces or their family
edge_cases.action: Armed forces personnel can register with civilian GP or use Defence Medical Services. Special rules may apply.

edge_cases.description: Applicant lives in residential or nursing care
edge_cases.action: Care home residents have right to register with GP of their choice. Care home may have arrangements with specific practices.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is asylum seeker or refugee
edge_cases.action: Asylum seekers and refugees are entitled to free NHS primary care. No immigration checks required for GP registration.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has recently moved and proof of address is not yet available
edge_cases.action: Practice should accept alternative evidence such as tenancy agreement, utility bill, or letter from previous address.
